name: torana_namespaces
description: List Torana and installed plugin namespaces with their status and purpose.

name: torana_describe
description: Describe a namespace or operation, including input, access policy and conversation scope.

name: torana_search
description: Find reachable Torana operations by intent. Optionally restrict the search to one namespace.

name: torana_invoke
description: Invoke a Torana operation. Reads run directly; changes require user confirmation. Never request or submit confirmation codes.
